svg.title: Evolve through use. Evaluate independently.
svg.desc: Rounds 1, 2 through n repeat task use, feedback, requirements and OpenAgents delivery to improve the Harness. The final round only tries the resulting Harness; independent Harbor evaluation follows and does not feed back into evolution.
svg.text: Round n: final trial only · no further delivery
Round 1: try the seed Harness, collect feedback, deliver an update.
Round 2: try the new version; feedback drives the next update.
Round n: a final trial, without another delivery batch.
Freeze the final Harness and start a separate held-out evaluation.
Run held-out Harbor tasks; their results do not feed the evolution loop.
Record scores and traces independently. The animation then restarts.
